note: Single source of truth for how every vulnerability-weights.json indicator's raw Habitation value becomes a 0-1 normalized indicator (METHODOLOGY §2.1/§2.2). 'method' is MINMAX (the raw value is already an inherently 0-1 share/fraction — min/max are 0/1), REFERENCE_RANGE (an open-ended raw value like a distance or a duration, clamped against a chosen realistic planning range and scaled to 0-1), or BOOLEAN (a presence/absence flag — min/max are unused placeholders). 'direction' DIRECT means higher raw value -> higher (more vulnerable / more capable, depending on the indicator) normalized value; INVERSE flips it (normalized = 1 - scaled), mirroring the DIRECT/INVERSE convention already used in factor-reclassification.json. services/ml/app/engine/vulnerability.py never hardcodes a normalization bound — every min/max/direction comes from this file.

foundationTypeRisk.note: Raw value is NOT numeric on Habitation — structures.predominantFoundationType (NONE/RUBBLE/STONE_MASONRY/RCC) is mapped to a 0-1 risk score by the FOUNDATION_TYPE_RISK lookup in vulnerability.py before this (identity) normalization is applied.
